programme.title: Legends of Venom
programme.desc: Kyyt ovat yksi maailman pelätyimmistä käärmesuvuista. Nyt tarinat paljastavat, kuinka vaikeaa vihatun käärmeen elämä on. Aavikoiden kalkkarokäärmeet huijaavat kuolemaa niin ihmisten kuin saalistajien käsissä. Kyyt ovat mahtavia tuholaistorjujia, mutta niitä jahdataan silti. Gaboninkyyt, jotka asuvat metsän aluskasvillisuuden seassa, eivät uskalla liikkua. Tutustumme syvällisesti niiden kohtaamiin haasteisiin, joista ne selviävät ainutlaatuisilla kyvyillään.

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: Eläinlääkäri Pol toivottaa uuden eläinlääkärin tervetulleeksi klinikalle, ja tämä auttaa tiimiä potilasaallon kanssa. Eläinlääkäri Pol hoitaa paikallisen poliisikoiran loukkaantunutta tassua. Nicole tutkii tappeluun joutuneen palveluskoiran, Lisa tikkaa hevosen suuren haavan ja Brenda hoitaa kissan palanutta raajaa. Toisena työpäivänään Olivia hyppää mukaan toimintaan ja auttaa Lisaa lehmän poikimisessa.

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: Chihuahuan hätäsynnytys saa eläinlääkäri Nicolen korkeaan valmiustilaan, kun hän yrittää pelastaa emon ja pentujen hengen. Klinikalle kelataan erikoinen kissan ja kalastuskoukun tapaus, kun taas ennenaikaisena syntynyt vuohi ja säikähtänyt maastohevonen tarvitsevat kumpikin apua silmävaivoihin. Eläinlääkäri Pol pohtii ikiaikaista kysymystä: karkea vai sileä?

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: Kaikki tuntuu olevan yhteydessä, kun eläinlääkärit näkevät tapauksissaan tiettyjä kaavoja. Tiimillä riittää puuhaa, kun he hoitavat peräkkäin australianpaimenkoiria, hengitysoireista kärsivien eläinten aaltoja ja pattien sekä möykkyjen ryntäystä. Vaikka oireet, rodut ja nimet voivat tuntua samankaltaisilta, kahta identtistä tapausta ei ole.

programme.title: Maailman kuolettavimmat – parhaat palat
programme.desc: Syvä ja sininen meri on uskomaton paikka, jota monet ovat tutkineet. Siellä asuvat myös yhdet maailmat vaarallisimmista saalistajista – nimittäin hait.

programme.title: Maailman vaarallisin hai
programme.desc: Joidenkin arvioiden mukaan valkopilkkahai on hyökännyt ja syönyt lähes 2 000 ihmistä – enemmän kuin valkohait, tiikerihait ja härkähait yhteensä. Voisiko kaikkein vaarallisin hai olla vieläkin vaarallisempi?

programme.title: Maailman suurin valkohai?
programme.desc: Kolme kokenutta sukeltajaa ja valokuvaajaa lähtee pienellä veneellä tallentamaan mereneläviä, joita Oahun rannikon lähellä kelluva kaskelotin ruumis on houkutellut paikalle. He kokevat erään uskomattomimmista valkohaiden kanssa tapahtuneista kuvatuista kohtaamisista.

programme.title: Maailman suurin tiikerihai
programme.desc: Meribiologi Kori Garza ja kuvaaja Andy Casagrande jäljittävät tiikerihaita.

programme.title: Haikalojen taistelu
programme.desc: Floridassa tallentui videolle harvinainen tapahtuma meripetoeläinten välillä: härkähait hyökkäsivät isovasarahain kimppuun. Tohtori Heithaus ja haiasiantuntijoiden tiimi käynnistävät tutkimuksen. He selvittävät, mitä tapahtuu, kun nämä kaksi petoa kohtaa.

programme.title: Bertie Gregory - lähikuvassa vasarahait
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory matkaa Meksikon Baja Californiaan jäljittämään yhtä merten erikoisimmista pedoista: vasarahaita. Laji oli aikoinaan vesistön yleinen näky, mutta nyt sen kanta on romahtanut. Bertie selvittää syitä katoamiseen ja mahdollisuuksia lajin elpymiseen.

programme.title: Haihyökkäysten taustat
programme.desc: Gracetownissa, Australiassa, kaksi surffaajaa joutuu hyökkäyksen kohteeksi vain muutaman tunnin välein samalla rannalla. Uudessa Etelä-Walesissa toinen surffaaja selviää hädin tuskin hengissä, kun valkohai puree hänen lautaansa. Ja Tampassa, Floridassa, nuori härkähai vahingoittaa tyttöä, joka harrastaa suppailua perheensä kanssa. Surffauspaikoilla ympäri maailmaa hait hyökkäävät surffaajia vastaan hälyttävän usein. Tuoreiden tietojen mukaan surffaajat muodostavat kolmanneksen maailmanlaajuisista provosoimattomista hainpuremista. Mikä aaltojen ratsastuksessa saa hait näkemään punaista? Tutkijat selvittävät kauhistuttavia läheltä piti -tilanteita ja raakoja hyökkäyksiä Amerikasta Australiaan. He tutkivat todisteita ja testaavat teorioita selvittääkseen, miksi surffaajat ovat edelleen haiden hyökkäyslistalla kärkisijoilla, toivoen voivansa pelastaa ihmishenkiä.

programme.title: Valkohain paluu
programme.desc: Valkohaita on alkanut muuttaa ennätysmäärin lähelle yhtä Uuden-Englannin suosituimmista turistikohteista, ja ne saalistavat tavoin, joita ei ole koskaan aiemmin havaittu. Ymmärtääkseen, miksi hait tulevat sinne ja mitä se merkitsee Cape Codin kannalta, tieteilijätiimi on alkanut tutkia tätä kasvavaa ilmiötä tavoitteenaan varjella ihmisiä. Mutta ovatko hait muuttamassa luonnollista ekosysteemiä vai palauttamassa sitä entiselleen?

programme.title: Bertie Gregory - lähikuvassa vasarahait
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory matkaa Meksikon Baja Californiaan jäljittämään yhtä merten erikoisimmista pedoista: vasarahaita. Laji oli aikoinaan vesistön yleinen näky, mutta nyt sen kanta on romahtanut. Bertie selvittää syitä katoamiseen ja mahdollisuuksia lajin elpymiseen.

programme.title: Äärimmäisyyksien eläimet: Parhaat palat
programme.desc: Siat voivat haistaa hajun maasta kahden kerroksen syvyydeltä. Koiran vainu taas voi viedä sinut oikeuteen.

programme.title: Alaskan lentopelastajat
programme.desc: Lentokoneet ovat Alaskassa ehdottomia, sillä niillä voi toimittaa elintärkeitä tarvikkeita ja pelastaa kadonneita tai loukkaantuneita alueilla, joille tiet eivät vie. Rankat säät ja äärimmäinen maasto luovat maan vaarallisimmat ilmailuolosuhteet, joita lentäjien on kestettävä saadakseen työnsä hoidettua kaikin keinoin. Kolmiosaisessa erikoisohjelmassa tutustutaan vaaralliseen ammattiin ja hurjapäiden ottamiin riskeihin.

programme.title: Antarktis
programme.desc: Scientists deployed to Antarctica are accustomed to frigid temperatures, but few have experienced the condition one storm that is sweeping over Scott Base and the Ross Ice Shelf. A condition one storm is categorized by visibility less than 100 feet, wind speed over 60 miles per hour or air temperature less than negative 100 degrees. The consequences can be deadly. Scott Base shuts down all missions and flights to and from western Antarctica have been canceled; leaving them more isolated from the outside world than ever. The scientists already 60 miles away from the safety of base on the Ross Ice Shelf have no choice but to stay in their tents and hunker down until the storm subsides. Those on the water aren't faring any better. 2000 miles away, a team studying minke whales is stranded from their main vessel because of snow reducing visibility, and the US Coast Guard en route to help resupply the continent is nearing the perpetual weather system that swirls around Antarctica.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The Crikvenica Riviera is one of the most scenic parts of the Adriatic coast with a rich diversity of attractive beaches, green hinterland, a continental wooden area, a climate that provides perfect refreshment in the summer time and just the right amount of action-packed fun in the sun. Find out more in this episode of Sail-ho Croatia!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Welcome, sailors! In this episode of Sail-ho Croatia we arrive to the incredibly beautiful, fragrant and action-packed island of Cres. The islands of Cres and Lošinj are connected to the ancient legend of Jason and the Argonauts in their search for the golden fleece aboard the Argo. Stick around to find out the best spots in these islands!

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this episode we will visit the old town and the palace of the grand master, before we refresh ourselves in the Kallithea Springs, and discover why Rhodes is considered as the sailing Mecca of the Dodecanese. We’ll take a trip to the beautiful Stegna beach to dive in the immaculate crystal blue waters, before venturing out on a SUP, a stand-up paddle board, to experience the unique and ever-growing practice of SUP Yoga. Finally, we’ll visit Panagia Tsambika, a hilltop monastery considered by some to be miracle-working.

programme.title: Discovering Saint Maarten
programme.desc: The island of Saint Maarten is one of the most captivating island of the entire Caribbean. Being split into two nationalities, while hosting many more, a hub of diverse excitement is brought there. Experience a 12 meter sailboat race, planes flying 50 overhead on a crystal blue watered beach, a long street filled with cultural fusion, a wildlife tour, and a underwater helmet-diving excursion by the side of a helicopter and submarine wreck.

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa
programme.desc: The Vic Bay Classic takes place in the winter months so expect the biggest swells and highest quality of surfing. Watch former CT contender fight for the win as the crowd cheers their local hero. The fight for the mens series winner gets even closer at this final event. programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Tour

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: Throughout the season, the four stops offered nail-biting action in breath taking venues that brought the best out of these dynamic and fast design foiling catamarans. The level of expectation and the anticipation was extremely high and both the organizers and the participants proved that it was worth waiting for the comeback. Let’s remember the most notable moments of what was a fascinating season full of top-level sailing battles in some crystal clear blue waters.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Inside Sailing
programme.desc: We start our journey in Spain, visiting a truly world-class regatta: the 50th Trofeo Princesa Sofia Iberostar. Then we move to Montenegro for the 44 Cup that enters a new era under a new brand name but still has the top sailors competing in this high-performance event. After, we change scenery and dive in the crystal clear waters of Villasimius in the 2019 Melges 20 World League. These speedy boats offer unique moments at the 1st event of the European Division.We could not end this trip vefore watching the historical Dragon boats in action. This all-time classic started their tour from Cannes and it proves to be an amazing experience.

programme.title: Barcolana 51
programme.desc: For all sea and sailing lovers and those who would never miss this one-of-a-kind show, the place is always the same every year: Trieste. Founded in 1969 thanks to the initiative of the yacht club Società Velica di Barcola e Grignano, the Barcolana competition has won its worldwide renown. Barcolana, the international sailing regatta with the world’s highest number of participating sailboats, is now in its 51th edition, and continues to offer that unique combination of sailing competition and great entertainment. Over 2,000 boats line up at the start line, sailed by world-class helmsmen, racing enthusiasts and cruisers, all fascinated by an event which every sea dog should experience at least once in their life. Follow this year’s competition of Barcolana 51: the international regatta that has won the Guinness World Record for the greatest sailing race.

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup
programme.desc: Welcome back to this edition of the Atlantic Cup. It is time for the third and final leg of the competition, the inshore series. Dragon and Gryphon Solo 2 are tied for, and teams have added 4 extra crew, allowing them to push their boats around the tight courses in Naragannset Bay. Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: 52 Super Series
programme.desc: Established as the world’s leading grand prix for monohull yacht, the 52 Super Series is a yacht racing circuit like no other. The circuit grew from the ashes of the TP52 MedCup that finished in 2011 in an initiative by three key stakeholders who enjoyed this race so much they wanted to keep it alive.The 52 Super Series embraces like-minded individuals and crews in venues and locations enjoyed by all. This is a series for the best. From Olympic medallists to America’s Cup victors, the dockside is filled with talent.Watch the racing circuit as yachts speed well over 20 knots and representing sailors from over 20 different nationalities in this sustainable event. Competitors race on a simple first-past-the-post format, so real time racing is all that matters, as there is no post-race time compensation.Find out what makes the 52 Super Series the best monohull racing in the world.

From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Durban Extravaganza
programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. The City of Durban and Durban Stars have brought the heat to the beautiful beachfront with the Surfing South Africa sanctioned Pro Surf Tour competition. Over 3 three days, the top 100 surfers gather in the South African city to participate in the hottest surfing competition of the African country.You can expect high-level competition with waves that are over 2-3 foot in Durban Extravaganza. Competing at the Bay of Plenty, surfers will surely dive in for plenty of action. A fanta-SEA for surf lovers!

programme.title: Sailing to the Games
programme.desc: Follow sailors from around the world as they prepare to compete on the world's greatest sporting stage and make history at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

programme.title: Sailing to the Games
programme.desc: Follow sailors from around the world as they prepare to compete on the world's greatest sporting stage and make history at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

programme.title: Discovering Symi
programme.desc: Welcome to Greece and the beautiful island of Symi in the middle of the Aegean Sea. Symi is part of the Dodecanese island chain, located about forty-one kilometers northwest of Rhodes, featuring fifty-eight-point one square kilometers of mountainous terrain. In this episode we will witness the beauty of Symi’s capital, Gialos, and its neighbouring district of Chorio.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show
programme.desc: In this episode 9 of Maxiboat, we test an Italian RIB with the incredible Capelli Stradivari 43. Then, we take a look back at the 2021 edition of the Nautic (Paris Boat Show) and a selection of the sailing and motor boats that were not to be missed. Finally, we are back to traditional sailing and motor yachting with the most beautiful pictures of the Monaco Classic Week 2021 edition.

programme.title: Jump On Board
programme.desc: The Aegean Sea is a mythological setting where western culture started from. Along with our two sailors, Zita and Abi, Mia will be mooring in Skyathos, and the girls are already more aware of the journey that lies ahead of them. This will trully be an amazing journey to make them become true sailors. Are you joining us?

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup
programme.desc: Welcome back to this edition of the Atlantic Cup. It is time for the third and final leg of the competition, the inshore series. Dragon and Gryphon Solo 2 are tied for, and teams have added 4 extra crew, allowing them to push their boats around the tight courses in Naragannset Bay. Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The Crikvenica Riviera is one of the most scenic parts of the Adriatic coast with a rich diversity of attractive beaches, green hinterland, a continental wooden area, a climate that provides perfect refreshment in the summer time and just the right amount of action-packed fun in the sun. Find out more in this episode of Sail-ho Croatia!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Welcome, sailors! In this episode of Sail-ho Croatia we arrive to the incredibly beautiful, fragrant and action-packed island of Cres. The islands of Cres and Lošinj are connected to the ancient legend of Jason and the Argonauts in their search for the golden fleece aboard the Argo. Stick around to find out the best spots in these islands!

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa
programme.desc: The Vic Bay Classic takes place in the winter months so expect the biggest swells and highest quality of surfing. Watch former CT contender fight for the win as the crowd cheers their local hero. The fight for the mens series winner gets even closer at this final event. Who will claim victory and take the overall series winnings in the season finale of the City Surf Series?

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: Throughout the season, the four stops offered nail-biting action in breath taking venues that brought the best out of these dynamic and fast design foiling catamarans. The level of expectation and the anticipation was extremely high and both the organizers and the participants proved that it was worth waiting for the comeback. Let’s remember the most notable moments of what was a fascinating season full of top-level sailing battles in some crystal clear blue waters.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Bing (S)
programme.desc: Joskus pelottavat jutut eivät olekaan niin pelottavia. Bing ja Nicky ovat yökylässä Sulan luona, mutta Bing on unohtanut Hoppityn kotiin! Raapiva oksa pelottaa Bingiä, eikä hän saa lohtua Sulan Hepotista. Amma soittaa Flopille, ja häntä odotellessa he kaikki leikkivät kutitusleikkiä Nickyn kanssa. Kun Flop tulee, hänellä on mukanaan Hoppity ja oma makuupussi, joten hänkin jää yökylään!

programme.title: Muumilaakson tarinoita (S)
programme.desc: Merenneito ja lohikäärmeen kyynel. Rannalle on ajautunut haavoittunut merenneito. Hänet voi parantaa lohikäärmeen kyyneleellä. Muumipappa muistaa lohikäärme-ystävänsä Edvardin.

programme.title: Smurffit (7)
programme.desc: Kausi 3. Jakso 46/52. Smurffit palaavat entistäkin smurffimpina! Liity rakastettujen sinisten hahmojen seuraan, kun he lähtevät UUSIIN seikkailuihin, jotka vievät alkuperäisen sarjan hurmaavuuden, hullunkurisuuden ja huumorin aiempaakin pidemmälle. Smurffaten matkaan! Lastenohjelma.

programme.title: LEGO Friends: Uusi luku (S)
programme.desc: Avajaisiin on enää muutama tunti, ja Autumn yrittää saada Aliyan vapaaksi terkkarilta. Olly ja Paisley pitävät viime hetken koe-esiintymiset.

programme.title: Linea Blu
programme.desc: Porti d'Italia, la trasmissione condotta da Donatella Bianchi e Livio Beshir, realizzata in collaborazione con il Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti e l'Autorità di Sistema Portuale. Il viaggio di Donatella ha inizio su una nave scuola dal porto di Ortona, uno dei nodi logistici più importanti dell'Adriatico centrale, alla scoperta di un tratto di costa dove i protagonisti indiscussi sono i trabocchi, le affascinanti macchine da pesca che si slanciano sul mare. Con Livio Beshir ci spostiamo lungo la Via Verde che collega Ortona a Vasto per scoprire tradizioni e segreti legati al mare, raccontando una storia millenaria fatta di pesca, ingegno ed amore per il territorio. Donatella prosegue la sua navigazione verso sud per un racconto della Riserva Naturale Regionale di Punta dell'Acquabella e del Cimitero dei Canadesi, luogo di trincee, nascondigli e fortificazioni, nonché teatro nel 1943 della battaglia di Ortona tra tedeschi e truppe alleate, uno degli episodi bellici cruciali per la campagna di liberazione dell'Italia. Livio raggiunge, invece, un peschereccio di rientro da una battuta di pesca, per assistere alla lavorazione dei mitili prima dello scarico in porto. Il viaggio prosegue tra Ortona e Civitanova Marche, a bordo di una grande unità navale impegnata in attività di pulizia delle vecchie condutture e del fondale marino. Infine, occhi puntati sul molo nord del porto di Ortona, per assistere alle più impegnative operazioni di imbarco e sbarco, con l'arrivo periodico di grandi navi che trasportano cereali e altre importanti materie prime.

programme.title: Passaggio a Nord Ovest
programme.desc: In questa puntata: nel sud del Perù sorge una città inca, disabitata da diversi secoli ma ancora praticamente intatta: Machu Picchu. Ripercorriamo la storia di una donna che ha battuto diversi record importanti, ma non è una sportiva: questa donna straordinaria è Marie Curie. Ci trasferiamo a Lucca e precisamente nel suo Duomo, un gioiello architettonico che custodisce dei tesori. Il viaggio continua in India, precisamente nello stato del Kerala dove scopriamo il festival del Theyyam ovvero la 'danza divina'. Ci rechiamo a Udine per visitare Impressionismo e modernità. Capolavori dal Kunst Museum di Winterthur, un progetto espositivo di rilevanza internazionale. Un programma di Alberto Angela. Con la collaborazione di Vito Lamberti ed Emilio Quinto.

programme.title: Musica Mia
programme.desc: Un viaggio alla scoperta di Firenze e delle sue due anime musicali, una più rock e una più pop: Lorella Boccia e Marco Conidi esplorano proprio quest'ultimo lato del capoluogo toscano, fatto di melodie e testi introspettivi che parlano di sentimenti e vita quotidiana. A bordo di un pulmino d'epoca, Lorella e Marco raggiungono Firenze e incontrano una delle protagoniste indiscusse della musica pop fiorentina, Irene Grandi, che li accoglie sul terrazzo dell'ex Teatro Nazionale, recentemente restaurato, luogo scelto per il videoclip del suo singolo Fiera di me. Il viaggio prosegue poi con Lorella Boccia che raggiunge il Parco di Pratolino, dominato dal maestoso Gigante dell'Appennino, dove ogni anno si svolge il Musart, uno dei festival più importanti dell'estate fiorentina, raccontato da Claudio Bertini. Nel frattempo Marco incontra il cantante Paolo Vallesi nei pressi di Ponte Vecchio per una chiacchierata tra amici, per poi raggiungere Villa Favard, sede distaccata del Conservatorio di Firenze, dove duetta con Aleandro Baldi, ricordando insieme il ruolo fondamentale del grande paroliere Giancarlo Bigazzi. Successivamente, Marco fa tappa in un negozio di vinili del centro storico dove lo aspetta Simona Bencini per ripercorrere i successi dei Dirotta su Cuba. Nel frattempo, Lorella si sposta a Pistoia per raccontare un'eccellenza artigiana italiana: l'azienda della famiglia Tronci, che da generazioni produce piatti per batteria esportati in tutto il mondo, guidata ancora con passione dal novantenne Luigi Tronci affiancato dal percussionista Gennaro Scarpato. Nel corso della puntata c'è anche il contributo dell'attore Edoardo Sylos Labini, dedicato a una delle canzoni più iconiche legate alla città, Firenze Santa Maria Novella di Pupo, e in chiusura il musicista Ambrogio Sparagna guida il pubblico alla scoperta delle origini della musica tradizionale legata alla città di Firenze.

programme.title: Linea Verde Estate
programme.desc: Con Margherita Granbassi e Nicola Tinto Prudente, il viaggio di Linea Verde prosegue sull'isola di Ischia, la perla più grande del Golfo di Napoli. Ischia Porto: i nostri conduttori si ritrovano appena scesi dal traghetto, pronti per una nuova avventura. Un luogo simbolo dove si fondono storia, natura e arte: ad Ischia Ponte, alla scoperta del cuore verde dell'isola, il Castello Aragonese, un ecosistema unico fatto di giardini, orti e vigneti. Il verde dell'agricoltura: in località Barano, nella parte sud-est dell'isola, in una piccola azienda agricola, con Filippo, contadino custode, la coltivazione e la raccolta di ortaggi e frutta. Il verde dei giardini botanici: a Forio, passeggiando tra piccoli viali, ruscelli e piante di ogni tipo, la magia dei giardini La Mortella, uno dei tesori botanici più straordinari d'Europa. Il verde della vigna e del tufo: in località Serrara Fontana, l'appassionato racconto di una viticoltura eroica che la famiglia D'Ambra porta avanti da generazioni. Il verde nel piatto: a Forio, direttamente dall'orto alla cucina, per preparare il mazzo di fiori prelibata ricetta a base di verdure di stagione. Il verde del benessere: a Lacco Ameno, il fenomeno del termalismo già conosciuto al tempo degli antichi romani. Il verde della Natura: sul versante occidentale dell'isola d'Ischia, tra i comuni di Serrara Fontana e Forio, la prepotente bellezza del bosco della Falanga, magnifico castagneto a 600 metri di altezza alle falde del Monte Epomeo. Il verde che diventa arte: a Forio, con Bettina, lo splendore dei colori dell'Isola trasferiti su lana, seta e cashmere per dare vita a capi ed accessori moda unici ed originali. In finale: in località Barano, con i musicisti della Scuola del Folklore, le emozioni condivise di un viaggio giunto al termine.

programme.desc: Zwischen Natascha und Cheyenne herrscht Funkstille. Bärbel lädt in Fulda zur großen Feier ein, doch nur zwei Ochsenknechts erscheinen. In Dubai träumt Jimi vom Durchbruch als Unternehmer.

programme.title: Das Vermächtnis des geheimen Buches
programme.desc: Der Historiker und Schatzjäger Ben Gates bekommt einen neuen Hinweis, wo der geheimnisvolle Schatz der Tempelritter verborgen sein könnte. Mit seinem Kumpan Riley und Ex-Freundin Abigali macht sich Ben wieder auf die Suche. Doch auch der skrupellose Geschäftsmann Wilkinson ist hinter dem Schatz her. Nur wer in den Besitz des Geheimen Buches des US-Präsidenten gelangt, wird den Tempelritter-Schatz finden. Abenteuerfilm von Jon Turteltaub, mit Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger und Ed Harris.

programme.title: stern TV am Sonntag
programme.desc: Gefährliche Raupen: Warum der Eichenprozessionsspinner sich immer weiter ausbreitet und wie man sich schützen kann / Zum Start der Sommerferien: wie funktioniert eigentlich ein Campingplatz? Ein Blick hinter die Kulissen / Lipödem: Curvy-Model Angelina Kirsch spricht offen über das Leid von Millionen Frauen / Im Koma geboren: wie es Lena und ihrer Mutter heute geht

programme.title: Das Vermächtnis des geheimen Buches
programme.desc: Der Historiker und Schatzjäger Ben Gates bekommt einen neuen Hinweis, wo der geheimnisvolle Schatz der Tempelritter verborgen sein könnte. Mit seinem Kumpan Riley und Ex-Freundin Abigali macht sich Ben wieder auf die Suche. Doch auch der skrupellose Geschäftsmann Wilkinson ist hinter dem Schatz her. Nur wer in den Besitz des Geheimen Buches des US-Präsidenten gelangt, wird den Tempelritter-Schatz finden. Abenteuerfilm von Jon Turteltaub, mit Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger und Ed Harris.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Die junge Tennisspielerin Claudia Weber steht erstmals im Finale eines Profiturniers. Doch am Morgen vor dem Spiel wird sie tot aufgefunden. Die Obduktion zeigt, dass sie schon früher schwere Kopf- und Hirnverletzungen erlitten hat.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Die Frau eines New Yorker Kollegen wird entführt, und in einem Weinfass wird eine Leiche gefunden.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Estefan Mejia ist es gelungen, die regimetreue kubanische Sängerin Silvana Cuerto nach Las Vegas zu holen. Nach der Probe finden Silvana und ihr Manager Antonio Silvanas Schwester Marta tot in der Garderobe. An der Wand steht die Botschaft, dass Silvana die Nächste sei. Die Ermittler vermuten zuerst einen Racheakt von Exil-Kubanern. Doch dann entdeckt Greg die familiären Zusammenhänge zwischen Estefan Mejia und den Cuerto-Schwestern.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Häufig sind sie gemeinsam vor Ort, wenn rund um einen Polizeieinsatz medizinische Erstversorgung gefragt ist. Der Blaulicht Report erzählt Geschichten aus dem aufregenden Berufsalltag dieser Retter in Not.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Zwei Jugendamtsmitarbeiterinnen verschwinden spurlos während eines Einsatzes in einer Problemfamilie. Die Beamten sind in höchster Alarmbereitschaft, denn der bereits vorbestrafte Familienvater scheint vor nichts zurückzuschrecken.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Sara ist an ihrem Geburtstag allein im Hotel. Dort lernt sie Taylor kennen und verbringt den Abend mit ihm. Als Taylor am nächsten Morgen ermordet aufgefunden wird, gerät Sara gerät unter Verdacht. Sie wird vom Dienst suspendiert. Schon bald erkennt sie, dass Ronald Basderic ihr offensichtlich eine Falle gestellt hat. Da Sara glaubt, unter ihren Kollegen keinen Rückhalt zu haben, will sie Basderic allein zur Strecke bringen.

programme.title: Deutschland am Morgen
programme.desc: Dein Morgen, dein Rhythmus: Deutschland am Morgen von RTL und ntv ist der tägliche Begleiter für alle, die bestens informiert und gut unterhalten in den Tag starten wollen. Von 6 bis 9 Uhr liefert das Nachrichtenmagazin die wichtigsten Themen und ordnet sie verständlich ein. Ob Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport oder Service: Feste Rubriken und spannende Talks sorgen für den richtigen Takt am Morgen.

programme.title: Rahalla saa (16)
programme.desc: Kolme hyvin erilaista ihmistä kohtaa Tukholman alamaailmassa, ja seuraukset ovat väkivaltaiset. Jorge on karannut vankilasta. Mrado on jugoslavialaismafian velanperijä. JN on töissä kaupungin kuumimmissa mestoissa.

programme.title: Terveysmatka (S)
programme.desc: Pysyvästi tollo Stig Helmer ja hänen elämäniloinen norjalaiskaverinsa Ole ovat palanneet! Yhdessä he kokeilevat terveysbisneksen ja new agen uusia tuulia. Reissullaan he tapaavat metsästäjiä, kananpoikia, vakuutusrahoja ja niin edelleen.

programme.title: Elvira Madigan (12)
programme.desc: Luutnantti Sixten Sparre rakastuu intohimoisesti nuorallatanssijatar Elvira Madiganiin. Hän pakenee armeijasta, ja pariskunta pakenee Tanskaan. Pian todellisuus lyö kasvoille, ja rakkaudenhuumaista kesäidylliä varjostaa kuoleman pelko.

programme.title: Kommissarie Späck
programme.desc: Komisario Mårten Späck kutsutaan rikospaikalle, josta on löytynyt veitsiä, haarukoita, lusikoita ja muita ruokailuvälineitä täyteen tikattu ruumis.

programme.title: Ryövärimetsä (S)
programme.desc: Perustuu Astrid Lindgrenin tarinaan. Peter on ollut metsässä leikkimässä ryöväriä. Mummo on pyytänyt häntä syömään kauan sitten, mutta kun hän tulee sisään, mummoa ei näy. Salongissa istuu Mimmi-nukke. Peter kohottaa puista miekkaansa...

programme.title: Se pikkuinen Lotta
programme.desc: Perustuu Astrid Lindgrenin tarinaan. Pikkuinen, jääräpäinen Lotta herää eräänä aamuna väärällä jalalla. Hän haluaa oppia ajamaan pyörällä ja lähtee hankkimaan itselleen ajopeliä.

programme.title: Angel (12)
programme.desc: 80-luvulla Angelica Holst oli juhlittu rocktähti, mutta moneen vuoteen hänen levynsä eivät ole soineet hittilistoila. Hän yrittää epätoivoisesti päästä takaisin lehtien kansiin ja lavastaa oman kuolemansa. Seuraukset ovat arvaamattomat.

programme.title: Päivä päivältä (12)
programme.desc: Kertomus siitä, ettei irtiotto elämässä ole koskaan liian myöhäistä. Demontoitunut Tage sekä Malte ja Rut asuvat vanhainkodissa. Siellä työskentelevät myös hoitaja Katrin ja siivooja Simon. Yhdessä tämä viisikko reissaa matkailuautolla halki Euroopan täyttääkseen vanhan miehen viimeisen toiveen. Ohjaaja: Felix Herngren. Rooleissa: Martina Haag, Sven Wollter, Marianne Mörck, William Spetz, Tomas von Brömssen, Peter Magnusson, Felix Herngren. (Ruotsi, 2022.)

programme.title: Bitchkram (12)
programme.desc: Kristin odottaa malttamattomana ylioppilaaksi pääsyä ja jännittävää elämää New Yorkissa kaukana rasittavasta siskostaan. Paikallinen lehti on luvannut julkaista Kristinin tarinoita kaupungista, joka ei koskaan nuku. Kristin kuitenkin myöhästyy New Yorkin -lennolta ja päättää häpeissään piiloutua maaseudulle merkillisen Andrean kotiin.

programme.title: Kidz in da Hood (7)
programme.desc: Musiikkipitoinen koko perheen elokuva Aminasta, joka on odottanut kolme vuotta oleskelulupaansa. Kun hänen isoisänsä kuolee, kaikki menee sekaisin.

programme.title: Offside (S)
programme.desc: Menestyskomedia Stenforsin jalkapallojoukkueesta, joka taistelee välttääkseen jo suljetun paperitehtaan kohtalon.

programme.title: Buss till Italien (12)
programme.desc: Ruotsalaisdraama kuorosta bussimatkalla Italiassa. Useimmat mukana olijat iloitsevat mahdollisuudesta paeta arkea, jotkut enemmän kuin toiset.

programme.title: Golffari (S)
programme.desc: Huonosti harkittu vedonlyönti pakottaa Stig Helmer Olssonin lähtemään Skotlantiin ja pelaamaan suureen suosioon noussutta golfia. Hänen golfopettajansa on Roderick McDougall, hullu mies jolla on hyvin kaunis tytär.

programme.title: Metsästäjät 1 (16)
programme.desc: Ampumakohtauksen jälkeen poliisi muuttaa takaisin Norlantiin yhteiskuntaan, jota hallitsevat kirjoittamattomat lait.

programme.title: Polta nämä kirjeet (12)
programme.desc: Tosipohjaiseen kirjaan perustuva ruotsalaisdraama 1930-luvulla eletystä intohimoisesta kolmiodraamasta, jonka jälkikaiut ulottuvat nykypäivään saakka.

programme.title: Kohtauksia eräästä avioliitosta (12)
programme.desc: Draama Johanista ja Mariannesta, jotka ovat eläneet 10 vuotta porvarillista avioelämää ja joita pienet tapahtumat vievät aina kauemmas toisistaan.

programme.title: The Stig-Helmer story (S)
programme.desc: Seuramatkan, hiihtoloman, purjehduksen, golf- sekä terveysmatkailun jälkeen Stig-Helmer on täällä taas! The Stig-Helmer Story on aikamatka nuoruusvuosiin 1950-luvulle.

programme.title: UFO Sweden (12)
programme.desc: Nuorisokotiin sijoitettu kapinallinen teini Denise epäilee, ettei hänen isänsä ole oikeasti kuollut, vaan ufot ovat kidnapanneet hänet. Niinpä hän pyytää ufoja tutkivan UFO Sweden -järjestön apua, jotta totuus selviäisi. Tämä johtaa vaaralliseen seikkailuun, joka vie Denisen kauas lain rajojen ulkopuolelle - uforetkien, salaliittojen ja selittämättömien ilmiöiden maailmaan.

programme.title: Vaahteramäen Eemeli ja Iida (S)
programme.desc: Kissankulman talossa, Vaahteramäen kylässä Smoolannissa asuu Eemeli ja hänen pikkusiskonsa Iida yhdessä isä Anttonin, äiti Alman, renki Aatun ja piika Liinan kanssa. Eemeli on kultainen pikkupoika, joka haluaisi kovasti olla avuksi, mutta hänen avuliaisuutensa helposti mielletään metkuiluksi.

programme.title: Lotta osaa kaiken (S)
programme.desc: Lotta on rämäpäinen viisivuotias. Tänä aamuna Lotta on raivoissaan, koska äiti on käskenyt häntä pukemaan päälleen inhottavan kutisevan puseron. Kaikessa hiljaisuudessa Lotta leikkaa siihen suuren reiän.

programme.title: Bäst före (7)
programme.desc: Draamakomedia kolmesta vanhasta ystävästä, jotka voittavat rahaa raveissa ja päättävät lähteä Suomen-risteilylle.

programme.title: Susi (7)
programme.desc: Ruotsalaisdraama erakko Klemensistä, joka huolehtii itsestään Norlannin metsissä ja joutuu konfliktiin Tukholmassa laadittujen lakien kanssa.

programme.title: Maastamuuttajat (7)
programme.desc: Klassinen draama Karl-Oskarista ja Kristinasta, jotka 1800-luvun puolivälissä jättävät pulakauden Smålandin päämääränään unelmien Amerikka.

programme.title: Populäärimusiikkia Vittulajänkältä (16)
programme.desc: Reza Bagherin filmatisointi Mikael Niemen kirjasta, joka on villi kasvukertomus, jossa Niila ja Matti oppivat tuntemaan rock'n'rollia ja omaa seksuaalisuuttaan juominkien ja saunomisen välissä 1960-luvun Pajalassa.

programme.title: Iso paksu isäni (S)
programme.desc: Rolf Lassgårdin Guldbagge-palkittu draama sijoittuu kesään 1959. Ruotsin pölyisillä teillä liikkuu Volvo PV kyydissään 11-vuotias Osvald ja tämän vanhemmat. Isällä on tapansa mukaan suuria suunnitelmia; hän aikoo opettaa kirkkokuorolle uuden messun, pelata jalkapalloa poikansa kanssa ja parantaa kuntoaan juoksemalla traktorin perässä.

programme.title: Jonain päivänä kaikki tämä on sinun (7)
programme.desc: Menestynyt sarjakuvapiirtäjä Lisa kokoontuu sisaruksineen vanhempiensa maatilalle ensimmäisen kerran yli kymmeneen vuoteen. Vanhemmat haluavat, että vain yksi sisaruksista perii suvun metsän. Mutta onko kukaan heistä halukas muuttamaan takaisin kotiin? Andreas Öhmanin (Avaruudessa ei ole tunteita) ohjaaman draamakomedian tähtinä ovat Karin Franz Körlof, Peter Haber, Suzanne Reuter ja Liv Mjönes.

programme.title: Valkoinen naarasleijona (16)
programme.desc: Komisario Wallander kutsutaan paikalle tutkimaan räjäytettyä taloa. Rikospaikalta löytyy pelkoa aiheuttavia johtolankoja: etelä-amerikkalaista alkuperää oleva pistooli, Venäjällä valmistettu radiolähetin - ja irtileikattu, musta sormi… Poliisi saa lisäksi tietoja etelä-afrikkalaisesta terroristiryhmästä, joka suunnittelee iskua joka tulisi muuttamaan maailmanhistoriaa. Kaikki jäljet tuntuvat johtavan Ruotsiin…

programme.title: Ormens väg på hälleberget (16)
programme.desc: Kertomus köyhästä leskestä, Teasta, jonka on pakko maksaa maanvuokransa luonnossa. Elokuva on kertomus 1800-luvun köyhän Ruotsin fyysisestä ja psyykkisestä ahdingosta. Bo Widerbergin klassikkoelokuva perustuu Torgny Lindgrenin romaaniin.

programme.title: Kohtalokas syrjähyppy (16)
programme.desc: Kaunis runoilija Clara rakastuu tulisesti John Hjortfeldtiin. Hän jättää mustasukkaisen miehensä Johnin takia. Perheellinen John taas alkaa elää kaksoiselämää. Clara huomaa, että häntä seurataan ja vahditaan. Kuka on asialla, ja miksi?

programme.title: Stieg Larsson: Mies joka leikki tulella (12)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen dokumenttielokuva Millennium-kirjojen luojasta Stieg Larssonista ja hänen riskialttiista tutkimuksistaan äärioikeistoryhmien parissa.

programme.title: Vingar av glas (12)
programme.desc: Nazli on syntynyt Irakissa ja varttunut Ruotsissa. Hän haluaa sulautua yhteiskuntaan ja kutsuu itseään Saraksi, mikä surettaa hänen isäänsä, joka haluaa hänet naimisiin irakilaisen kanssa. Pian Sara tapaa Johanin, mikä ei helpota tilannetta.

programme.title: Loranga, Masarin ja Dartanjang (7)
programme.desc: Loranga on maailman paras isä. Vaikka hän on aikuinen, hän rakastaa poppia eikä halua mennä töihin, koska leikkii poikansa Masarinin kanssa. Dartanjang asuu vajassa, koska pelkää bakteereita. Hän on siitä huolimatta jatkuvasti kipeänä.

Kilpailemassa Sere Siltala, Veikka Markkanen, Roponen, Kevin Tran ja Eero ”Suhis” Suhonen. Pisteitä jakaa Viki Eerikkilä.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Pariskunta eksyy sumussa Käsivarren erämaahan. Kaipainen ja Airaksinen lähtevät pelastustehtäviin. Ivalossa Näkkäläjärvi ja Vasenius saavat seuraajan.

programme.title: Frédéric Chaslin, Orchestra of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie, Choir of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie And Jodie Devos - Delibes - Lakmé
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin (1963) leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Léo Delibes’s tragic opera Lakmé (1883). Written to a libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille, the opera is set in nineteenth-century British India and tells the story of Lakmé, who falls in love with Gérald, a British officer. However, Lakmé’s father, the Brahmin priest Nilakantha, vows revenge after he discovers that Gérald has trespassed on their sacred ground. Like many of his contemporaries, Delibes was fond of exoticism, evoking foreign lands and cultures in the tradition of Georges Bizet’s Les Pêcheurs de perles (1863) and Camille Saint-Saëns’s Samson et Dalila (1877). Delibes’s opera features the celebrated “Flower Duet,” sung by Lakmé and her servant Mallika as they gather flowers by the river, and also the wonderful coloratura aria “Bell Song” (Air des Clochettes). Among the soloists are Jodie Devos, Philippe Talbot, Lionel Lhote, Pierre Doyen, and Marion Lebègue. This production was recorded at the Opéra Royal de Wallonie in Liège, Belgium, in 2022.

programme.title: Ben van Gelder And Reinier Baas - jazzahead! 2024 - Ben van Gelder And Reinier Baas
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead! paid special attention to the jazz scene of the Netherlands and invited over forty jazz acts to perform over the course of three days. Among the acts presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is the duo of alto saxophonist Ben van Gelder and guitarist Reinier Baas. These two prominent figures in the Dutch jazz scene have a long-standing musical partnership, having performed together hundreds of times. Ben van Gelder and Reinier Baas are celebrated for their dynamic yet refined stage synergy and innovative performances. Their concerts seamlessly combine complex compositions with spontaneous improvisation, offering a compelling display of contemporary jazz, highlighting the innovative spirit of the Dutch jazz community.

programme.title: Ed Harcourt, Carl Barât And Peter Doherty - Sgt. Pepper Tribute at Philharmonie de Paris 2017
programme.desc: Celebrated as one of the most influential albums of all times, The Beatles' 1967 Sgt. Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band marked its time and inspired generations of artists. While the album was purely a recording studio product, Beatles’ fans continue to be frustrated by not hearing it live. British musician and composer Ed Harcourt, author of six highly acclaimed albums and collaborator of vocalists Marianne Faithfull, Patti Smith, and trumpeter Erik Truffaz, gathered a supergroup for this occasion with top artists from the British independent rock scene. Join Ed Harcourt and members of The Libertines, Supergrass, The Coral, the Beta Band, and Primal Scream for this special tribute.

programme.title: Itamar Erez Quartet - jazzahead! 2022 - Itamar Erez Quartet
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the performing bands is the Itamar Erez Quartet. Pianist and guitarist Itamar Erez was born in Israel, studied composition in Cologne and London, then went back to Jerusalem. Currently based in Vancouver, the guitarist-composer’s music has a sensitivity that touches listeners profoundly. His unique sound blends Middle Eastern music’s delicacy, the freedom found in jazz, and the passion of flamenco. Erez is accompanied by clarinetist Francois Houle, bassist Jeff Gammon and drummer Kevin Romain.

programme.title: Jeditah van der Meulen, Brendan Jan Walsh And Jordy Pama - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Jeditah
programme.desc: Jeditah is an experimental songwriter, producer and singer from Amsterdam. She works with Brendan Jan Walsh on cello and Jordy Pama on synths and electronics. From an early age on, Jeditah has been immersed in the world of music, travelling with her parents as a music collective. She finds inspiration in the works of acclaimed artists like Björk, James Blake, Laurie Anderson and PJ Harvey. When she began experimenting with making her own music, she first only utilized her own voice, lowering and altering it, and eventually adding electronic beats and synths. With Electric AlleyCat, Jeditah has established her position as a singer and songwriter. In between performing and recording with the band, she creates layered soundscapes from old recordings and homemade samples. It's here where she develops her very own sound: playful, melancholic and adventurous – music that speaks to the imagination of the listener. In this concert from 2019's Classical:NEXT!, she performs Horseman You And Me, Lay Down, The Night, Differently and Private Space.

programme.title: Alexandre Cavaliere - Belgium Sessions: Cavaliere and Mohy Duo
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this performance by violinist Alexandre Cavaliere and pianist Pascal Mohy. This recording marks the first time that these talented, rising jazz stars share the same stage. They tackle material made famous by, among others, jazz legend Miles Davis.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons, Berliner Philharmoniker And Vadim Repin - Waldbühne 2002 - Night of the Encores
programme.desc: In front of a cheering audience, Mariss Jansons conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker and violinist Vadim Repin as part of an evening devoted to the most popular recalls at the Walbühne in Berlin. One of the most impressive outdoor scenes in Europe, the Walbühne hosts the Berliner Philharmoniker each summer, performing in front of an audience of some 20,000 people. The 2002 edition of this annual concert celebrates the reminders frequently performed by major orchestras and ensembles. The Berliner Philharmoniker performs for the occasion with Russian-born Belgian violinist Vadim Repin, the youngest laureate of the Queen Elisabeth Music Competition in Brussels, played under the direction of many renowned conductors, including Simon Rattle, Valery Gergiev and Mariss Jansons. The evening's program moves from de Wagner to Tchaikovsky, from Sibelius to John Williams, and ends with the ultimate reminder: Paul Lincke's Berliner Luft!

programme.title: Raul Midón - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: The Libertines - The Libertines - At Olympia Paris 2016
programme.desc: Firstly, there was a successful reunion on stage at Leeds and Reading in 2010, then a concert at Zénith Paris, and not a single listener was left untouched. After playing Glastonbury and other summer festivals, the English rock band The Libertines are definitely back with their album Anthems For Doomed Youth. With this new tour de force, the group (with original members Pete Doherty, Carl Barat, John Hassall, and Gary Powell) opens a new chapter in history. Anthems For Doomed Youth, highly acclaimed by the press, is their first since their studio album Libertines, now a British rock classic, topped the charts back in 2004. Join this legendary foursome at the Olympia in Paris for an evening of pure rock!

programme.title: Kim Hoorweg - Kim Hoorweg at BIRD, Rotterdam
programme.desc: After Dutch singer Kim Hoorweg landed her first record contract from Universal Music at the age of 14, her musical career took off and she became a well-known name in the Netherlands jazz community. Famous artists such as Candy Dulfer, Raul Midón, Metropole Orkest, and Gino Vannelli, to name a few, have already performed with the singer on numerous occasions. This time, Kim Hoorweg performs at BIRD in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, together with fellow Dutch musicians Anton Goudsmit on guitar, Niels Broos on keyboards, and Yoran Vroom on drums.

programme.title: John Cage - How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers. From 1982 to 1992, Scheffer worked with Cage on numerous occasions, which resulted in unique archives of historical audio-visual material, including interviews, musical performances, and images of locations related to the composer’s life and work. In all Scheffer’s works related to Cage, he used the old Chinese method of chance operations based on the Yi Jing – as often used by Cage himself in his compositions. Instead of using chance operations, Scheffer edited the film in the usual way that is based on choice.

programme.title: Fabrizio Rat - Fabrizio Rat
programme.desc: Since his teenage years, Fabrizio has worked simultaneously on both classical and electronic music productions. He’s definitely not the classical music guy who has just discovered techno. Throughout his apprentice years at the musical academy in Turin, he was working as a producer in dance music studios at the same time, hiding his “double life” to both the professors and the DJs. Arriving in Paris in 2007, his objective starts to take shape. Fabrizio combines the acoustic sounds and weird harmonics of his prepared piano with the acid loops of the TB-303 and the beats of the TR-909. Unsurprisingly, it’s in front of the dancefloor, in clubs or festivals, that Fabrizio plays his live sets. With the right hand, he plays repetitive rhythmical patterns while the left one handles the machines and manipulates the piano strings. Enjoy his 2019 show at Trabendo Paris!

programme.title: Al Di Meola, Chris Carrington And Arto Tuncboyaciyan - Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here. With second guitarist Chris Carrington and percussionist Arto Tunçboyacıyan, Meola performs the now-classic world-fusion repertoire from his album 'World Sinfonia', which was originally released in 1991.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig - Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically. The Norwegian premiere followed a few months later. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016.

programme.title: Arthur Wagenaar - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Close Call
programme.desc: In Close Call your smartphone is a musical instrument. And you are not just an audience member, but a musician in a crazy band with three drummers! Arthur Wagenaar is a Dutch composer and musician. He has a deep love for rock bands, theatre, opera and classical music, and his music is usually a mixture of all of this. He also loves to invent his own instruments, mechanical or electronic, such as the “rampaphone,” a string instrument nine meters in length, the “kleurwerper,” played by juggling, and of course the Close Call Live app. In this performance from Classical:NEXT! in Rotterdam, he is supported by Joep Hendrickx, Tjalling Schrik, Marijn Korff de Gidts, Boy van Ooijen, Dodó Kis, Sarah Jeffery, Lotte Pen, Matthias Konrad, and Axel Schappert.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chris McQueen, Jason JT Thomas, Henry Hey And Kevin Scott - Mondriaan Jazz 2017: FORQ
programme.desc: Forq is an instrumental quartet with an aggressive sound and a penchant for sonic exploration. Originally founded by keyboardist Henry Hey (David Bowie, Empire of the Sun, and Jeff Tain Watts) and bassist Michael League (Grammy-winning founder of Snarky Puppy), Forq is joined by guitarist Chris McQueen and drummer Jason JT Thomas. Their group sound draws from various musical paths of its members, whether it’s Jason’s swampy grooves and shuffles, Chris’ singular sonic approach to guitar, Henry’s zeal for unique keyboard sounds and twisted ear candy, or Michael’s driving world-influenced grooves. The band pushes further down the sonic rabbit hole with their stunning music. This concert was filmed during Mondriaan Jazz Festival 2017, The Hague.

programme.title: Sammy Price - Sammy Price and the Harlem Beggars
programme.desc: Pianist, singer and civil rights activist Sammy Price is joined by the gospel singers known as the Harlem Beggars for spirited renditions of “Go Tell It on the Mountain,” “I’m a Soldier,” and “When the Saints Go Marching In,” among several others. The group is joined by Wilbert Harrison, who provides accompaniment on organ.

programme.title: Jeffrey Tate And Mozarteum Orchester Salzburg - Mozart - Symphony No. 31, K. 297
programme.desc: Jeffrey Tate conducts the Mozarteum Salzburg Orchestra in a performance of Mozart’s “Paris” Symphony No. 31 (K. 297). Mozart composed the work in 1778, during his unsuccessful job-hunting time in Paris. The opening movement of the “Paris” symphony is one of the grandest and most thrilling sounds Mozart ever made from an orchestra. The composer used the clarinets for the first time in a symphony, having heard the new instrument earlier in Mannheim. With horns, trumpets, timpani, and a full section of woodwind with flutes, oboes, clarinets, and bassoons, it is the biggest orchestra the composer had used until then. This broadcast is directed by János Darvos.

programme.title: Momchil Atanasoff - Portrait: Open Source Trio
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano - Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris. The main section of the ballade is built from two main themes which return in different keys after which a thundering chord introduces the Presto con fuoco, which eventually ends the piece in a fiery double octave scale run down the keyboard. The work gained popularity after appearing on the soundtrack to the 2002 Roman Polanski film The Pianist, where it is played by Janusz Olejniczak.

programme.title: Another Thought - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Riccardo Chailly, Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, Gewandhaus Choir Leipzig And Manuela Custer - Rossini - Petite messe solennelle
programme.desc: Gioacchino Rossini's Petite Messe Solennelle was written in 1863, the last, the composer called it, of my péchés de vieillesse (sins of old age). For its first performance (1864) Rossini arranged the work with only two pianos and harmonium. Partly for fear that it would be done anyway after his death, Rossini discreetly orchestrated the Petite Messe Solennelle during 1866-67, without losing its candor and subtlety. The resulting version had its first public performance on 28 February 1869, three months after the composer's death. Mr Chailly's genius for the Rossini style has ripened with the years. His performance has daring and velocity”. Chailly conducts the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, the Gewandhauschor and the Choir of the Leipzig Opera in an orchestral version from the Gewandhaus in Leipzig in 2008.

programme.title: Lex Jasper, Frits Landesbergen And Edwin Corzilius - Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode. Following his car accident, Lex nearly joined the leagues of Netherland's “forgotten” jazz heroes, though he is still considered one of the most important artists and composers of his generation and Dutch jazz history. Jasper played and recorded with all the greats, including Toots Thielemans, Clark Terry, Joe Pass, and Rita Reys.

programme.title: Kamil Slezák, Tomáš Liška, Nikola Zarić And Efe Turumtay - Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its participating bands, Invisible World, is based at the jazz crossroads where East European and Mediterranean influences merge and caper off in new directions. Led by Czech bassist Tomáš Liška, a prolific idea man of many projects, joined by Turkish violinist Efe Turumtay, Serbian accordionist Nikola Zarić and Moravian drummer Kamil Slezák.

programme.title: Desiree Basilia Diego, Sheldon Cecil Petillo, Denmark Jason Flores And Horace Orlando Flores - The Garifuna Collektive - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, The Garifuna Collective, carries the legacy of Andy Palacio who not only put the music of Belize on the world stage, it also inspired a generation of Belizean musicians to look to their roots. Featuring an intergenerational line-up and the rousing vocal prowess of the Umalali women singers, they celebrate the deep cultural roots of Garifuna music, with the emblematic sound of the two traditional Garifuna drums – the primero and the segunda – along with maracas, turtle shells, jawbones and acoustic and electric guitars and bass grooves.

programme.title: Kenny G - Kenny G - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. After beginning his career in the Love Unlimited Orchestra, he now brings his own band for this hypnotic performance.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartet No. 5, Op. 18, No. 5
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.

programme.title: Rene Pape - My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn - Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn’s concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda - Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn. Since 2012, Prosseda also gives lecture-concerts with the robot pianist TeoTronico, as educational or family concerts, to demonstrate differences between a literal production of music and human interpretation.

programme.title: Friedrich Gulda - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Ellen Pels, Tibor Elferink, Tony Hoyting And Joost Visser - Ellen Pels - Love 2/2
programme.desc: Dutch jazz singer Ellen Pels presents her latest release, “Love.” Recorded live at Theater Odeon in Zwolle, the Netherlands, Ellen is joined by The Red Limo String Quartet and her own nine-piece rhythm section. The singer combines her passionate love for music with her own, stirring lyrics, inspired by spiritual philosophers like Paulo Coelho, Eckhard Tolle, and Deepak Chopra. Her spiritually saturated music is challenging and theatrical, yet warm and melodic.

programme.title: Gottfried von der Goltz - Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret? The internationally acclaimed pianist and Bach expert Robert Levin provides an answer.

programme.title: Armin van Buuren - This is Me
programme.desc: An up close and personal registration of the This is me solo shows by Armin that took place in Amsterdam June 22. After a period of reflecting and producing new music during the pandemic, Armin van Buuren returned to the stage in a magnificent way. Unique concert footage combined with an indepth interview and backstage material.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa - Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.

programme.title: Itzhak Perlman, Berliner Philharmoniker And Daniel Barenboim - Brahms - Violin Concerto
programme.desc: Israeli violinist Itzhak Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic perform Johannes Brahms' Violin Concerto (1833-1897) under the direction of Daniel Barenboim. After Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Brahms' piece is probably the most famous German Violin Concerto ever written. These two works have much in common, especially the tone in D major in which they were composed. Highly technical, Brahms' Violin Concerto is reserved for virtuosos because of the marked presence of arpeggios, rapid passages of scales and rhythmic variations. Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic are brilliantly meeting the challenge of this technically and intellectually demanding work.

programme.title: Rob Mostert - The Hammond© Sessions: Rob Mostert Hammond Group
programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with DJAZZ, the programme ‘Mostert Meets’. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes centre stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role. The Hammond B3 is an electric organ, which generates sound by creating an electric current from rotating a metal tonewheel near an electromagnetic pickup. Initially, the Hammond B3 was at home in churches, until it entered the jazz scene in the mid-20th century. In this episode, Mostert performs with his Rob Mostert Hammond Group, of Rob Mostert (Hammond B3), Jurriaan Suring (guitar), Chris Strik (drums), Efraim Trujillo (saxophone), Michael Rorby (trombone) and Michael Simon (trumpet).

programme.title: Lithany of the Peaks - jazzahead! 2023
programme.desc: In 2023, jazzahead! paid special attention to Germany’s jazz scene and invited thirty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the groups presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2023 is Paris-based trio La litanie des cimes. Violinist Clément Janinet, clarinetist Élodie Pasquier, and cellist Bruno Ducret regard improvisation as free and introspective – but not reclusive.

programme.title: Thalma de Freitas - MPB Sessions - Thalma de Freitas
programme.desc: Thalma de Freitas is a Brazilian singer, songwriter, and actress from Rio de Janeiro. Daughter of the renowned pianist Laércio de Freitas, her work is a masterful fusion of MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), jazz, and Afro-Brazilian influences. In 2019, her album ‘Sorte!’ was nominated for a Grammy Award. For this intimate performance, she is joined by guitarist Helô Ferreira. How do contemporary artists reinterpret tradition and create new forms of expression within MPB? Da Pá Virada Sessions' MPB Series investigates this question. Hosted by Dani Gurgel, this episode features a live performance and thought-provoking conversation with Thalma de Freitas, exploring her unique fusion of styles and inviting audiences to discover the richness of modern Brazilian music. Continue your journey into the rich world of contemporary Brazilian popular music on Stingray DJAZZ.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 And 13, and Op. 133
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 7 in F major, Op. 59, No. 1, known as “Razumovsky”; String Quartet No. 13 in B-flat major, Op. 130; and the monumental Great Fugue, Op. 133. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on October 12, 2020.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson And Niels-Henning Orsted Pedersen - Oscar Peterson with NHØP - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1979, legendary Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson gave a stunning performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With talented double bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen accompanying him, Peterson demonstrated his piano skills with aplomb.

programme.title: Heloise Werner, Oliver Pashley, Anne Denholm And Marianne Schofield - The Hermes Experiment
programme.desc: The Hermes Experiment, consisting of Heloise Werner (soprano), Oliver Pashley (clarinet), Anne Denholm (harp) and Marianne Schofield (double bass) is a UK-based contemporary quartet made up of harp, clarinet, voice and double bass. Capitalising on their deliberately idiosyncratic combination of instruments, the ensemble regularly commissions new works, as well as creating their own innovative arrangements and venturing into live free improvisation. The ensemble has commissioned over 50 composers at various stages of their careers. During this showcase recorded at Classical:NEXT 2019 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands, The Hermes Experiment performs “I Am Happy Living Simply'”and “The End of the Ending” by Emily Hall, “Samsara” by Alex Mills, and “Double Fiesta” by Meredith Monk.

programme.title: Oum El-Ghait Benessahraoui, Yacir Rami, Damian Nueva Cortes And Camille Passeri - Oum - Music Meeting Festival 2018
programme.desc: Oum El Ghait Benessahraoui, who is better known as Oum, gives a unique glance at ethnic Morrocan musical esthetics. The singer-songwriter is considered to be the ambassador of Morrocan culture, too. Deeply influenced by gospel, jazz, soul and RAndB genres, today Oum mixes more and more African music genres, such as Sufi, Hassani, or Afrobeat. Yet, the singer’s voice still echoes the colours of Aretha Franklin, Ella Fitzgerald or Whitney Houston. It is the African American vocal tradition that made a huge impact on Oum since her early days as the singer. Performing from Music Meeting Festival in Nijmegen, The Netherlands, Oum charms the stage with an exotic sonic journey to the undiscovered lands of North Africa.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti - Bach - Goldberg Variations, BWV 988
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach’s celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach’s masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria’s melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - On My Way To Harlem
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions. His rise since then has been meteoric. Porter’s magnificent, burnished baritone can sink into a lyric with luxurious ease, the melody gently sculpted into new shapes at every turn, with the rhythm tugging subtly back and forth across the bar line.
